name: Frame-Isolated Khronon-Vector (FIKV)
claimed_mechanism: This architecture introduces an independent standard-kinetic timelike vector u_mu that carries the off-ray lensing slip required by DC-013. The vector's longitudinal kinetic normalization is strictly independent of the screening factor e^-y, avoiding the P7 strong-coupling wall that killed previous stiff/non-propagating vector attempts. The screened preferred-frame coupling e^-y u_mu DPhi provides the necessary off-ray modification to the metric potentials in the MOND regime, while the massive vector's propagation is governed by a fixed stiffness parameter rather than the screening scale.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the massive vector u_mu mediates a preferred-frame interaction that is exponentially screened in the high-acceleration (Solar System) regime by the e^-y factor. This yields PPN parameters alpha_1 and alpha_2 that vanish as e^-y, satisfying the A3/P2 pattern. The lensing ratio eta is modified to track MOND dynamics (eta=1 + O(enhancement)) because the off-ray vector contribution is not locked to the delta-R direction by diffeomorphism invariance, as it is a distinct propagating DOF with independent kinetic normalization.
inequivalence_argument: This candidate is inequivalent to DC-010 (khronometric) because it introduces a distinct propagating vector u_mu with standard kinetic normalization, rather than relying solely on the khronon T. It is inequivalent to DC-014 (stiff vector) because u_mu is explicitly standard-kinetic and propagating, not stiff/non-propagating; its longitudinal mode has finite, independent kinetic normalization K~1, not K~e^-y or K->inf. It is inequivalent to DC-001/012/013 because it includes a preferred-frame carrier (u_mu), escaping the frame-free slip-lock theorem. The key architectural difference is the separation of the screening factor (e^-y in the coupling) from the kinetic normalization (fixed stiffness in u_mu's kinetic term), which is the exact requirement of the A3 principle to avoid P7.
